title: cereus pectinatus
intro: Cereus pectinatus, commonly known as Pincushion Cactus, is a species of cactus that belongs to the family Cactaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-boosting properties. The therapeutic actions of Cereus pectinatus include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote sleep, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
